page.content:
First emperor, who closed the civil wars and founded the principate.

How Augustus connects

  • Faction: Roman Empire — Augustus founded the principate that became the Empire.
  • Character: Mark Antony — Octavian defeated Antony at Actium.
  • Character: Julius Caesar — Augustus was Caesar's adopted heir and avenger.
  • Event: Battle of Actium — Actium left Octavian free to become Augustus.
  • Concept: Pax Romana — Augustus advertised the Pax Romana as the fruit of his settlement.

What is Augustus?

Octavian, Caesar's heir, defeated Antony and Cleopatra at Actium, took the name Augustus in 27 BCE, and ruled as princeps while leaving Senate and magistracies standing.

Key threads lead to Roman Empire, Mark Antony, Julius Caesar, Battle of Actium and Pax Romana.
